title: SkyBot Exploration
description: ExplorationTracker segment summaries (learning_kv exploration.*) and the EVALUATOR-ONLY position trace (positions table). The trace is never read by the agent.

panels.title: Position, top-down (X vs Z), by stream

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT x, z FROM positions WHERE stream = 0 AND t_wall BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY t_wall
SELECT x, z FROM positions WHERE stream = 1 AND t_wall BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY t_wall
SELECT x, z FROM positions WHERE stream >= 2 AND t_wall BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY t_wall

panels.description: A = stream 0, B = stream 1, C = every further stream. One point per trace line (every trace_every_steps steps). Each episode is a fresh world (CLAUDE.md 7): coordinates from different episodes are not the same place.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t_wall AS time, 'stream-' || stream AS metric, y AS value FROM positions WHERE t_wall BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY t_wall

SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'exploration.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'exploration.%.y_min' OR key LIKE 'exploration.%.y_max') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.title: Steps since a new cell

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(replace(key, 'exploration.', ''), '.steps_since_new_cell', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'exploration.%.steps_since_new_cell') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.description: The `stuck` alert fires when this stays > 5000 for 1 h.
